description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans grain migration features, including tests for migration initiation, migration inside grain lifecycle, migration with different state persistence techniques, and error handling during migration. It also defines several grain interfaces and classes used for testing migration scenarios.

classes.name: MigrationTests
classes.description: Test class containing various unit tests for Orleans grain migration features.

classes.name: MigrationTestGrain
classes.description: Sample grain implementing migration participant interface to facilitate migration testing, including dehydration and rehydration logic.

classes.name: MigrationTestGrainWithMemoryStorage
classes.description: Grain that uses in-memory state storage for testing migration with GrainState.

classes.name: MyMigrationStateClass
classes.description: Serializable class representing migration state for grains using Grain{T} for state.

classes.name: MigrationTestGrainWithInjectedMemoryStorage
classes.description: Grain that uses injected IPersistentState for state management, used to test state migration with persistent storage.
